# Sebas

> Crystal multi-account orchestratable personal agent platform.
> Binds N accounts per channel (email / WeCom / Lark), orchestrates trigger→condition→action
> workflows with durable tasks, hot-reloads configuration without restarts, and embeds mruby plugins.

Sebas is a personal agent platform written in Crystal. It manages multiple accounts across
communication channels, provides a persistent workflow engine with approval gates and budget
circuit breakers, supports hot-reloadable configuration, and runs plugins in an mruby sandbox.
The repository uses a structured development process with AI agent roles for implementation,
verification, triage, and release management.

## Development process

- [Workflow overview](https://github.com/ShiningRay/sebas/blob/main/docs/design/process/development-workflow.md): branch model, milestones, issue lifecycle, verification, and release process
- [Maintainer role](https://github.com/ShiningRay/sebas/blob/main/docs/design/process/maintainer.md): human decision-maker for scheduling, scope, freeze verdicts, and release approval
- [Implementer role](https://github.com/ShiningRay/sebas/blob/main/docs/design/process/implementer.md): AI agent that implements work packages, fixes review comments and CI failures
- [Verifier role](https://github.com/ShiningRay/sebas/blob/main/docs/design/process/verifier.md): AI agent that independently verifies deliverables (read-only, separate context)
- [Reviewer role](https://github.com/ShiningRay/sebas/blob/main/docs/design/process/reviewer.md): AI agent that performs final review after Verifier findings are resolved
- [Triager role](https://github.com/ShiningRay/sebas/blob/main/docs/design/process/triager.md): AI agent that triages issues into six verdicts and assigns metadata
- [Scribe role](https://github.com/ShiningRay/sebas/blob/main/docs/design/process/scribe.md): AI agent that maintains design docs, memory store, and CHANGELOG
- [Release Manager role](https://github.com/ShiningRay/sebas/blob/main/docs/design/process/release-manager.md): AI agent that executes version bumps, tagging, and asset verification

## Key facts

- Language: Crystal >= 1.19
- Package manager: Shards (bundled with Crystal)
- Native dependencies: libsqlite3 (with FTS5), OpenSSL, PCRE2
- Platforms: Linux (x86_64), macOS (x86_64 / arm64), Windows (x86_64)
- License: MIT
- Default branch: main (protected, squash-only, 4 required CI checks)
- Release automation: patch auto-release on fix commits, minor semi-auto via workflow_dispatch, major manual
- Version source of truth: src/version.cr (synced with shard.yml)
- Current version: 0.1.0
- Milestones: M4 (v0.2.0 fork-join), M5 (v0.3.0 commitments), M6 (v0.4.0 calendar mirror), M7 (v0.5.0 projection)
- CI: 3-platform spec + ameba + release build + docs-check + dependency-check
- Quality gates: crystal spec (0 failures), crystal tool format --check, ameba (0 issues), check_docs.py (FAIL=0)
